# HoloPinch

> Free browser AR toy by Liz: pinch one or both hands and a live holographic mesh locks between your fingers. MediaPipe HandLandmarker + WebGL + three.js. No app, no account, no backend.

## Product

- What: interactive hologram mesh driven by hand pinches in the browser camera
- Maker: Liz (https://lizliz.xyz/)
- Category: browser AR / WebApplication (toy)
- Stack: Vite + TypeScript + MediaPipe HandLandmarker + WebGL + three.js (static Cloudflare Pages)
- Price: free; no install, no account
- Data: camera stays local in the browser; no backend
- Languages: English (default), Chinese at `/zh/`

## How it works

- Camera wakes on its own (or open controls). Pinch or spread one or both hands.
- Closer + flat → foil card. Farther + open → crystal bar. Best with two hands.
- One `flatness` value drives opacity, edges, and foil.
- Without a camera (or if denied), demo orbs on stage still respond.

## What it is not

- Not a native AR app store download
- Not a multiplayer social product or account-gated SaaS
